mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Public Library. Please note the air quality index is 64, which is in the moderate range. Under the light of the full moon, look to the northwest near Verona High School at 6:34 AM to catch the International Space Station as it travels toward Madison.

The city has released the 2027 proposed budget for public review, and the Plan Commission is meeting on November 4th to discuss several developments, including the Ardent Glen plat and site plans for Milky Way and Liberty Business Park.

Today is packed with activities, including the Dane County Farmer's Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 26 and trivia nights starting October 27 at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Looking at the weekly report, on October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. Thankfully, no students were injured during the incident.
The flavor of the day is Turtle. Culver's is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
